item_name: Rothco Tactical Operator Cap With US Flag
item_short_desc: Elevate your mission-ready wardrobe with Rothco's Tactical Operator Cap with Embroidered US Flag, combining classic style with functional features. Crafted from durable, lightweight, and breathable material, this service-style hat offers comfort and resilience. The top loop patch is designed for an IR marker while the back loop field allows for branch or name tape attachment. 4 reinforced air holes provide optimal cooling airflow. With an adjustable hook and loop strap, this cap is one-size-fits-most.
